findings.statement: No blocking finding remains in the reviewed SQL-shaped slice. L-01 and L-02 remain pending and are non-blocking residual promotion risks.
findings.recommendation: Keep L-01/L-02 pending until real PostgreSQL/Auth/TLS, context-spoofing, two-process and live rollback evidence exists.

steelman.strongest_support: Repair completion is confined to reconcile with top-level authoritative receipt validation, completed status, non-empty identity, exact original turn matching and authoritative completed Core-commit proof. Direct completion is rejected, AdmissionGate requires a factory-created durable recorder and verifies timeout persistence identity, rollback rehearsal compares exact fixture sequence and expected values, and documentation explicitly scopes evidence to SQL-shaped policy state.
steelman.strongest_opposition: The reviewed evidence does not observe deployed PostgreSQL locking, required Auth/TLS, cross-process behavior or production writer rollback; those remain outside the closed SQL-shaped package.
